desc:
🏎️ RACE CARS - Open crates, collect cars and race your way to the top!

UPDATES EVERY SATURDAY! 

🏆 HOW TO PLAY
🏁 Races happen every 60 SECONDS!
🎲 Experience the race from behind the wheel!
💰 Better cars earn you MORE CASH!
⛽ Keep your cars FUELED UP and ready to race!

📈 GROW YOUR COLLECTION
📦 Open CRATES to unlock awesome new cars!
🔩 Explore the JUNKYARD and collect scrap from abandoned cars!
⬆️ Use scrap to increase your cars XP!
🎨 Customize each car with YOUR favorite colors!
🏠 Upgrade your GARAGE to hold even MORE cars!

💤 Your cars keep earning CASH while you're OFFLINE!

👍 LIKE + ⭐ FAVORITE for more updates!
